    {
      "question": "List all product names and their categories for active products only.",

      "difficulty": "easy",

      "simulated_answer": "小米空气净化器,家用电器",
      "answer_slot": "none",

    {
      "question": "How many paying users placed at least one valid order?",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",

      "simulated_answer": "4278",

      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count_distinct:user_id:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "Show the top 5 cities by total sales amount from valid orders.",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Group valid orders by users.city, sum paid_amount per city, order descending, limit 5.",
      "simulated_answer": "上海市",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:city:sales_amount:orders_users:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "What is the average order quantity per order item for valid orders?",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Average of order_items.quantity across all order items belonging to valid orders.",
      "simulated_answer": "2.34",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:avg:quantity:order_items:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "Which brand has the highest total sales amount among valid orders?",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Join orders → order_items → products; group by brand; sum item_amount for valid orders; return brand with max sum.",
      "simulated_answer": "云栖",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:brand:sales_amount:orders_items_products:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 1;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "For each category, compute total sales amount and total refund amount for approved refunds, both from valid orders.",
      "category": "join",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Join orders → order_items → products → refunds; filter valid orders and approved refunds; group by category; sum item_amount and refund_amount.",
      "simulated_answer": "家用电器,187421.60,3421.80",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "join:category:sales_refund:orders_items_products_refunds:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.category;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "What is the product refund rate for '手机数码' category?",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Approved refund amount divided by product sales amount, restricted to '手机数码' category and valid orders.",
      "simulated_answer": "0.0214",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "refund:rate:category:手机数码:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "List all refund reasons and their count of approved refunds.",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Count number of rows in refunds grouped by refund_reason where refund_status = 'approved'.",
      "simulated_answer": "七天无理由,127",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count:refund_reason:refunds:approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "Show the number of valid orders and total sales amount per month in 2026.",
      "category": "time",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "Group valid orders by YEAR(order_date) and MONTH(order_date); filter for year = 2026; sum paid_amount and count orders.",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-01,142,12478.90",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "time:monthly:orders_sales:2026:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS year, MONTH(order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND YEAR(order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY YEAR(order_date), MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY year, month;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
